decision: Teal + sand accepted by the user as working palette on 20 October 2026; final brand approval remains open.

roles.light: Teal symbol and complete name on porcelain.
roles.dark: Ivory symbol and complete name on teal for the preferred working treatment.
roles.accent: Flat soft gold in restrained layout details; not tiny body text on pale backgrounds.
roles.secondary: Sand supporting surfaces with teal text.

font: Instrument Sans title case 470 remains a working companion, not a finalized brand type system.
